shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal said at a joint press conference after a high-level international conference on implementing the two-state solution in New York that Gaza must not be separated from the West Bank and East Jerusalem, whether politically or territorially.

title: Saudi Foreign Minister Says Gaza Must Not Be Separated From the West Bank and East Jerusalem
